paper.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

objective: Reproduce the Cora test accuracy of the GCN in Table 2 ('GCN (this paper)') using this PyTorch port, following its README.

expected.why: Reproduced only after (a) three drift/hardware fixes so that it runs on CPU with current scipy/numpy and (b) using 400 epochs as the README hint says ('To achieve 81.7% on Cora dataset, pytorch need 400 epochs'). With the default 200 epochs the five-seed mean is about 0.79 with large variance (0.73-0.82).

notes: Table 2 of arXiv 1609.02907 (pdftotext): 'GCN (this paper)  70.3 (7s)  81.5 (4s)  79.0 (38s)  66.0 (48s)' and 'GCN (rand. splits)  67.9 ± 0.5  80.1 ± 0.5  78.9 ± 0.7  58.4 ± 1.7' (columns Citeseer, Cora, Pubmed, NELL). The claim here is the Cora entry of the 'GCN (this paper)' row: 81.5. Fixes: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigen.arpack import removed (01); np.bool/np.int removed from numpy (02); torch.device('cuda') hard-coded (03). env.path_or_config denotes the wrong default epochs (200 instead of the 400 the README says are needed). The seed in train.py is hard-coded (123) and the default run gave 0.572 on this setup; patch 90 is only a measurement aid adding a --seed flag so that >= 3 seeds can be run, it is not a root cause. Reference command: python3 train.py --epochs 400 --seed S.
